children: The acquisition strengthens Reliance Retail’s presence in B2B wholesale and expands its network of stores, merchants and supply-chain capabilities

Reliance Retail Ventures (RRVL), a subsidiary of Reliance Industries Limited, acquired a 100 per cent equity stake in METRO Cash & Carry India for a total cash consideration of Rs 2,850 crore, expanding its presence in the B2B wholesale segment.

The acquisition strengthened Reliance Retail’s retail and supply-chain network across India while providing access to METRO India’s established merchant relationships, strategically located stores and supplier network.

METRO India entered the Indian market in 2003 and became the first company to introduce the cash-and-carry business format in the country. At the time of the acquisition, the company operated 31 large-format stores across 21 cities and employed around 3,500 people.
The business had built a B2B customer base of more than 3 million registered customers, including around 1 million frequent buyers, through its stores and eB2B platform.
METRO India’s customer base included kiranas, small merchants and institutional customers across multiple categories.
For the financial year ended September 2022, METRO India reported sales of Rs 7,700 crore, its strongest sales performance since entering the Indian market.

For Reliance Retail, the acquisition provided access to METRO India’s store network, merchant relationships and supplier ecosystem. The integration also created opportunities to leverage synergies across supply chains, technology platforms and sourcing capabilities.The acquisition strengthened Reliance Retail’s ability to serve small businesses and merchants through an established B2B network.
The Competition Commission of India subsequently approved Reliance Retail Ventures’ acquisition of 100 per cent of METRO Cash & Carry India in March 2023.
The transaction marked an expansion of Reliance Retail’s presence in India’s organised B2B wholesale market, alongside its broader retail and supply-chain operations.
